title: 第6章 检测
slug: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
lines: 出租屋里。
陈峰靠着沙发摘下头盔，扯掉防毒面罩，又平复了一会儿呼吸，紧绷神经才渐渐松弛下来。
脑海中忍不住回忆起，刚刚所见到的那头巨大竹节怪物，
以及看到那怪物时，感受到那种钻入脑海的冰冷黏腻感觉。
他很确定自己查到的异种生物资料中，没有这种看一眼就能影响精神的怪物。
“这难道是……污染？”
陈峰想到一种可能。
实际上，
生物在高灵气环境下的异化其本质是进化，是在挖掘基因深处的优良性状。
而网上曾有传言，在现实世界的禁区深处灵气浓度越高的地方，就越有可能出现一种污染……
或者叫“畸变”更合适。
会将生物的进化引向某种不可名状的方向。
这类生物一般都极为危险，拥有种种千奇百怪、不可思议的能力。
要知道，现实世界禁区灵气浓度也才正常三倍左右。
如果这则传言为真，那眼下这个灵气浓度达到五倍的大墟世界，恐怕存在着更多恐怖怪物……
陈峰晃了晃脑袋，暂时压下了心中念头，算了多想无益。
他低头看了看右前臂伤口，已经被天衡喷雾封住，只剩一层白色药膜覆在上面，隐隐发痒。
显然是已经在修复了，应该要不了两天就能康复。
陈峰收回视线，
【基础格斗术Lv.1经验：85/100】
嗯，涨了三点？
陈峰回忆了一下，他记得，自己进入大墟世界之前，格斗术的经验值是82点。
也就是说刚才和那只铁鄂灰蜚的搏杀，直接涨了3点经验！
陈峰目光微微一亮。
要知道，他前段时间在学校上训练课的时候，
一节课九十分钟，对练加上实操，累的半死，经验值纹丝不动。
有时候连续上一周的课才能涨个一两点。
结果在大墟里跟一只蟑螂拼了一场命，三点就到手了。
“生死之间出真知啊……”
陈峰咂了咂嘴，这倒也能理解。
课堂上的训练再怎么模拟实战，终究还是安全的，身体知道自己不会死，潜能就逼不出来。
但在大墟里不一样。
每一次生死搏杀肾上腺素飙升，身体每一块肌肉，每一根神经都在极限运转，格斗技巧自然也就提升的很快。
陈峰把这个发现记在心里，随后开始整理今晚的收获。
心念一动，将个人空间中的物品逐一取出，摆在茶几上。
一共一株成年灰伞肺菇，二十四株幼年灰伞肺菇，一块铁鄂灰蜚的心脏，还有两片金属化的颚叶和几片完整的甲壳碎片。
陈峰看着茶几上这堆东西，略微想了想。
那株成年肺菇留着自己用，这个没什么好犹豫的。
成年肺菇虽然价值高，但今后还能在大墟世界中找到，现在反而是突破【气血关】对自己来说更加重要。
毕竟自己的实力越强，今后能在大墟中探索到的东西也就越多。
至于剩下的幼年体，直接挂出去卖就行了。
陈峰掏出手机第(1/3)页
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
夜深。

    陈峰依旧盘膝坐在客厅的地板上，感受着体内那股奔涌不息的暖流。

    气血如溪，潺潺而动。

    这就是突破【气血关】后的感觉。

    身躯中的每一处经脉都仿佛活跃起来，气血涌动之下，修行效率比之前高了至少五成。

    他正准备起身洗漱睡觉，沙发上的手机屏幕忽然亮了起来。

    嗡——

    是一条微信消息，备注名称：柔姐。

    【小峰，在吗？】

    【你们班导师今天给我打电话了，说你已经连续旷了半个月的课了，是不是出了什么事了？】

    陈峰看着屏幕上的文字，顿感有些头疼。

    周柔是他邻居家的姐姐。

    父母早亡后，陈峰基本就是靠着周柔一家的接济长大的，两人的关系和亲姐弟没什么区别。

    周柔大学学的财会，毕业后就进了天衡医药公司做会计。

    后来似乎是和老板的女儿处成了闺蜜，一路升迁，日子过的不错。

    陈峰之前手头紧的时候，也都是周柔转钱给他。

    没想到班导师梁越居然会直接联系到周柔那里去。

    陈峰思索片刻，手指在屏幕上敲击起来。

    【姐，我没事，就是前段时间身体不太舒服，休息了一阵。】

    随后消息秒回。

    【身体不舒服？严不严重？去医院看了没？】

    【看了看了，小毛病，已经好了。】

    【那你明天赶紧去上课，别再旷了，梁老师语气挺严肃的，我听着都替你捏把汗。】

    【知道了姐，明天就去。】

    【嗯，那你周末过来找我一趟，正好我这边有点事想跟你说。】

    【行。】

    【早点睡。】

    【好，姐你也早点睡。】

    ……

    结束聊天。

    陈峰将手机丢到一旁，长长吐出一口气。

    看来老梁这老小子，是真盯上自己了。

    武道学专业的每个班级，都会配备一名班导师，除了教课之外，还负责学生的日常修行和思想工作。

    陈峰的班导师就是梁越，一个年近四十的中年男人，平日里对学生尽心尽力，在三班风评极好。

    但这对于陈峰来说，可就难受了。

    毕竟他眼下可没功夫长时间待在学校里。

    “明天估计得挨一顿训。”

    陈峰心中暗道。

    不过现在的自己，倒也无需太过担忧。

    他微微握拳，感受着肌肉深处涌动的力量，心中已然有了打算。

    ……

    第二天清晨。

    陈峰被手机的提示音吵醒。

    从床上坐起拿过手机看了一眼，

    是白鱼APP的后台消息。

    已经有好几个买家发来私信，询问灰伞肺菇的情况，其中一个甚至一口气下了十株的单。

    陈峰简单回复了几句，告诉他们下午发货，随后起身检查了一下自己右臂上的伤口。

    经过一夜时间已经好的差不多了。

    随后他换好衣服，洗漱完毕，背上那个老旧的帆布包出门，在校门口的小吃摊随便啃了两个包子，便走进学校。

    今天上午八点的课，正好就是班导师梁越的《标准练气导论》指导课。

    陈峰来到B区2栋教学楼，走进三楼的训练室。

    训练室中颇为宽敞。

    武道三班的学生已经到了大半，三三两两的聚在一起，或是在做热身，或是在闲聊刷手机。

    陈峰的出现，立刻吸引了不少人的注意。

    只是那些投来的视线，都带着几分古怪。

    “陈峰！这儿！”

    训练室左侧靠窗的位置，吴志超正冲他招手，旁边还站着舍友林远。

    陈峰走了过去。

    “我的哥，你可算来了！”

    吴志超一脸同情的看着陈峰，压低声音道：

    “你完蛋了，刚才老梁来过一趟，专门问你来了没有。”

    林远也是一脸无奈：

    “看那架势，老梁这次是真火了，待会儿上课，你自求多福吧，估计得当着全班的面削你。”

    陈峰点了点头：

    “嗯，反正来都来了。”

    两人微微一愣，有些面面相觑：

    “有一说一，你小子这心理素质倒是真不错。”
content_en:
Late at night.

Chen Feng was still sitting cross-legged on the floor of the living room, feeling the endless warmth in his body.

Qi and blood are like streams, gurgling and moving.

This is the feeling after breaking through the [Qi and Blood Pass].

Every meridian in the body seems to be active, and with the surge of Qi and blood, the efficiency of practice is at least 50% higher than before.

He was about to get up to wash up and go to bed when the screen of his mobile phone on the sofa suddenly lit up.

Buzz——

It’s a WeChat message with the name: Sister Rou.

[Xiao Feng, are you there?】

[Your class teacher called me today and said that you have been absent from class for half a month. Did something happen?】

Chen Feng looked at the text on the screen and suddenly felt a headache.

Zhou Rou is his neighbor's sister.

After his parents died early, Chen Feng basically grew up relying on the support of Zhou Rou's family. The relationship between the two was no different from that of biological siblings.

Zhou Rou majored in accounting at university and joined Tianheng Pharmaceutical Company as an accountant after graduation.

Later, it seems that he became best friends with the boss's daughter, got promoted along the way, and lived a good life.

When Chen Feng was short of money before, Zhou Rou would always transfer money to him.

Unexpectedly, class tutor Liang Yue would contact Zhou Rou directly.

Chen Feng thought for a moment and tapped his fingers on the screen.

[Sister, I'm fine. I just wasn't feeling well some time ago and took a rest.】

Then the message comes back instantly.

【Feeling unwell?Is it serious?Have you gone to the hospital?】

[After looking at it, the minor problem has been cured.】

[Then you should hurry up and go to class tomorrow and don’t miss it anymore. Teacher Liang’s tone is quite serious, and I feel a little sweaty for you.】

[I know, sister, I’ll go tomorrow.】

[Well, then come and see me over the weekend. I happen to have something to tell you.】

【OK.】

【Go to bed early.】

[Okay, sister, you should go to bed early too.】

…

End the chat.

Chen Feng threw the phone aside and let out a long breath.

It seemed that this old boy, Lao Liang, was really targeting him.

Each class in the martial arts major will be assigned a class instructor who, in addition to teaching, is also responsible for the students' daily practice and ideological work.

Chen Feng's class tutor is Liang Yue, a middle-aged man in his late forties who is devoted to his students and has an excellent reputation in Class Three.

But this is uncomfortable for Chen Feng.

After all, he doesn't have time to stay in school for a long time right now.

"I'll probably get a lesson tomorrow."

Chen Feng thought to himself.

But now I don't need to worry too much.

He clenched his fist slightly, feeling the power surging deep in his muscles, and already had a plan in mind.

…

Early the next morning.

Chen Feng was woken up by the beep of his cell phone.

He sat up from the bed and took a look at his cell phone.

It is the background message of Baiyu APP.

Several buyers have already sent private messages inquiring about the status of P. cinerea, and one of them even placed an order for ten plants at once.

Chen Feng simply replied a few words and told them that the goods would be shipped in the afternoon. Then he stood up and checked the wound on his right arm.

It's almost healed after one night.

Then he changed his clothes, washed up, put on the old canvas bag and went out. He casually ate two buns at the food stall at the school gate, and then walked into the school.

The class at 8 o'clock this morning happened to be the "Introduction to Standard Qi Training" instruction class given by the class instructor Liang Yue.

Chen Feng came to the 2nd teaching building in Area B and walked into the training room on the third floor.

The training room is quite spacious.

Most of the students in the third martial arts class have arrived, gathering together in twos and threes, either doing warm-ups or chatting and checking their mobile phones.

Chen Feng's appearance immediately attracted the attention of many people.

It's just that the glances he cast were a bit strange.

"Chen Feng! Here!"

On the left side of the training room, by the window, Wu Zhichao was waving to him, and his roommate Lin Yuan was standing next to him.

Chen Feng walked over.

"My brother, you are finally here!"

Wu Zhichao looked at Chen Feng with sympathy and lowered his voice:

"You're finished. Lao Liang came here just now and asked specifically if you were here."

Lin Yuan also looked helpless:

"Look at that posture, Lao Liang is really angry this time. You will be lucky in class later. I will probably kill you in front of the whole class."

Chen Feng nodded:

"Well, I'm here anyway."

The two of them were stunned for a moment, looking at each other a little bit:

"Let me tell you, your kid's mental quality is really good."
